questions.explanation: strings.Fields splits a string around each instance of one or more consecutive white space characters, handling multiple spaces gracefully, which is ideal for basic shell tokenization.
Quoted arguments require stateful scanning to treat whitespace characters inside the quotes as literal characters rather than argument delimiters, complicating a simple stateless split.
Consecutive whitespace characters should be collapsed and ignored as delimiters, ensuring they do not produce empty string tokens unless specifically enclosed in quotes.
